title: content/palestine/events/<chapter>.yaml, one entry of events:
description: One event of a chapter (written by tools/tsv_to_events.py). Field names follow the GameEvent type in sim/StoryOfTheLand.Sim/Content.cs; a test keeps them equal. See docs/palestine-model.md.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.

title.description: May contain {village_en} or {village_ar} in a fate:* event (the family's village).

text.description: May contain {village_en} or {village_ar} in a fate:* event. No invented quotes.

scope.description: F4: whose family the event reaches. national (every family), region:<place id> (a family whose village is near that place) or fate:<fate> (the family's own village, in the month of that sourced fate; may use {village_en} and {village_ar}). Absent: national.

place.description: F4: the place (palestine/places.yaml id) where the event happened. Optional.

effects.description: F4: effects of the event itself, applied when it resolves, before the chosen option's.

tags.description: holocaust, terror, massacre, war-casualties, displacement and sensitive (F4: a massacre or killings, shown after a content note) are sensitive: a shareable build needs each such event sensitivity-reviewed (ReleaseGate).

to.description: End of the window (exclusive). Leave out for an open window.

day.description: The day of the From month the event happened, where its text dates it: a turn's cards come in date order (tools/tsv_to_events.py reads it from the text).

outcome.description: F4: what happened to the family after this choice (no historical claim).

target.description: A family resource id from palestine/model.yaml.

checked.description: The day you opened the source.

reviewed_by.description: The GitHub handle of the person who signed this row off (#375): written only by that person, never by an AI agent (scripts/oss/reviewed_by_guard.py); never an email. Needs reviewed_on.

reviewed_on.description: The day of that sign-off. Needs reviewed_by.
